sources.title: Ensuring Continued Accountability in Federal Hiring (Executive Order 14356)

status_summary: A presidential memorandum of 2025-01-20 froze hiring for vacant civilian positions across all executive departments and agencies, while exempting Senate-confirmed, certain noncareer Senior Executive Service and Schedule C and other noncareer appointments; it was to expire for most agencies once an OMB workforce plan issued. Executive Order 14356 of 2025-10-15 then set a continuing rule that vacant civilian positions are filled only with approval of agency strategic hiring committees. Both apply to DOL by their terms. No DOL-specific hiring freeze, count of DOL political appointees, or staffing action for the Office of Compliance Initiatives was found; the office's page remains on dol.gov but is undated.

timeline.event: Presidential memorandum imposes a hiring freeze on vacant federal civilian positions across executive departments and agencies, with exemptions.
Executive Order 14356 bars filling vacant federal civilian positions except through agency strategic hiring committee approval, with exemptions for certain non-career appointments.
